summary.text: Nicole Hasso is the Republican candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 43 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Jill Alesch.
Hasso is a financial services professional who has worked at Principal Financial Group.

paragraphs.text: Nicole Hasso attended Drake University, where she studied accounting and finance.
Hasso defeated Brett Nelson and Russell Saffell in the Republican primary for District 43 on June 2, 2026.
